title: Reply to Comment on “On the pass‐through rate of the Nutrition North Canada subsidy”
title_zh: 回复《关于加拿大北部营养补贴传导率的评论》
authors: Jamie Naylor, B. James Deaton, Alan Ker
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: en In Naylor, Deaton, and Ker (2025), we discuss an appropriate econometric method for estimating the pass-through of the Nutrition North subsidy in the presence of heterogeneous effects and endogenous sampling. Applying this method to the data set compiled by Galloway and Li (2023), who conclude that there is “large leakage” of the subsidy, we fail to find evidence that supports their conclusion. After our paper was published, Galloway and Li published both a corrigendum to their 2023 article and a comment to our paper based on that corrigendum. In their comment, Galloway and Li (2026) claim that after “minor but easily justified” changes to their original data, our econometric approach leads to either imprecise or incomplete estimates of pass-through. In our response we show that: (i) Galloway and Li (2026) choose a classification of market structure that differs from the one recommended by federal government officials and from the classification they themselves use in their most recent work, including Galloway and Li (2025b) and Li, Daley, and Watson (2025); (ii) the classification structure consistent with the recommendations of federal government officials and their aforementioned research supports full pass-through; (iii) Galloway and Li's (2026) removal of 75% of the original sample is not minor; and (iv) Galloway and Li's (2026) repeated emphasis on sub-sampling, robustness, and statistical power is incomplete and thus misleading. Importantly, our response emphasizes that the correct econometric approach does not turn on whether one can selectively find a data set in which the empirical estimate of pass-through changes.

title: Together We Tip the Scale: Social Norms and Body Mass
title_zh: 共同影响体重：社会规范与身体质量指数
authors: Margaris, Panos, Wallenius, Johanna
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a life cycle model that features food consumption, exercise, and deviation from reference BMI, which represents local social norms, to rationalize spatial concentration and the educational gradient in body mass in the US. BMI is determined by caloric balance and affects health and medical spending, the probability of survival, and the level of utility. We find that occupational strenuousness, food prices, medical expenditures, and labor income explain only a modest share of BMI differences across regions and education groups. Preference differences matter, but they account for the patterns only when amplified by social norms. To demonstrate the policy relevance of the social norm, we introduce a GLP-1 treatment policy targeting individuals with the highest food preferences. We find substantial direct effects on average BMI, with reductions of up to more than 6 pounds. Importantly, we document meaningful spillover effects arising from endogenous adjustment of reference BMI that further amplify these effects. The BMI reductions translate into substantial life expectancy gains for both treated individuals and untreated individuals through spillover effects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个涵盖食物消费、运动以及偏离参考BMI（代表当地社会规范）的生命周期模型，以解释美国体重指数的空间集中现象及教育梯度。BMI由热量平衡决定，并影响健康与医疗支出、生存概率及效用水平。研究发现，职业体力消耗强度、食品价格、医疗支出和劳动收入仅能解释不同地区及教育群体间BMI差异的较小部分。偏好差异虽具影响，但仅在社会规范放大作用下才能解释现有模式。为论证社会规范的政策相关性，我们针对食物偏好最高群体引入GLP-1治疗政策。结果显示，该政策对平均BMI产生显著直接效应，降幅最高超过6磅。更重要的是，我们发现了由参考BMI内生调整引发的显著溢出效应，进一步放大了这些影响。通过溢出效应，BMI的降低为治疗组与未治疗组均带来实质性的预期寿命增益。

title: Immigration, Workforce Composition, and Organisational Performance: The Effect of Brexit on NHS Hospital Quality
title_zh: 移民、劳动力构成与组织绩效：英国脱欧对NHS医院质量的影响
authors: Henrique Castro-Pires, Kai Fischer, Marco Mello, Giuseppe Moscelli
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Abstract Restrictive immigration policies can force organisations to alter their workforce composition, with unclear effects on organisational performance. We study the effects of the 2016 Brexit referendum, which reduced the share of EU-nationality nurses in English hospitals. Using administrative patient-level data and a continuous difference-in-differences design, exploiting hospitals’ pre-referendum exposure, we estimate the causal impact of a negative labour supply shock on care quality. Hospitals with higher pre-referendum EU nurse shares experienced higher post-referendum emergency patient mortality, equivalent to 1,238 additional deaths annually in the three years after the referendum. Consistent with theoretical predictions, hospitals responded to labour shortages by relaxing hiring standards: foreign nurses recruited after the referendum were appointed to lower salary grades, suggesting lower skills and experience.
abstract_zh: 限制性移民政策可能迫使组织改变其劳动力构成，但对组织绩效的影响尚不明确。我们以2016年英国脱欧公投为研究对象，该事件导致英格兰医院中欧盟籍护士比例下降。利用行政层面的患者数据以及连续双重差分设计，通过医院在公投前的暴露程度，我们估算了负向劳动力供给冲击对护理质量的因果影响。公投前欧盟护士比例较高的医院，在公投后急诊患者死亡率更高，相当于公投后三年内每年额外增加1,238例死亡。与理论预测一致，医院通过放宽招聘标准来应对劳动力短缺：公投后招聘的外籍护士被分配到较低薪资等级，表明其技能和经验水平较低。

title: El rol de la política fiscal y de las devaluaciones nominales en las estabilizaciones basadas en el tipo de cambio
title_zh: 财政政策与名义贬值在基于汇率的稳定化中的作用
authors: Braga, Rodrigo
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: En este trabajo incorporamos al análisis teórico clásico de Calvo y Végh (1990,1991) y Végh (1992) sobre planes de estabilización de alta inflación basados en el tipo de cambio, el rol de la política fiscal, entendida como la dinámica del gasto público y la implementación de una reforma impositiva, así como también el rol de las devaluaciones nominales. Encontramos que las dinámicas de la inflación, el tipo de cambio real y la actividad son mucho más diversas y complejas, aun en el caso de perfecta credibilidad, que en los modelos originales. En relación a las estabilizaciones con credibilidad imperfecta, podemos matizar la expansión en el producto que sugieren estudios como el de Kiguel y Liviatan (1992) y establecer condiciones bajo las cuales dicha expansión se atenúa o incluso puede llegar a desaparecer. Finalmente, si bien todos nuestros hallazgos son teóricos, estos traen consigo implicancias empíricas susceptibles de ser contrastadas en futuras investigaciones.
abstract_zh: 本文在Calvo和Végh（1990,1991）以及Végh（1992）关于基于汇率的高通胀稳定计划的经典理论分析框架中，引入了财政政策的作用——即公共支出动态与税收改革实施，以及名义贬值的影响。研究发现，即使在完全可信的情况下，通胀、实际汇率和经济活动的动态变化也比原始模型更为多样和复杂。关于不完全可信的稳定计划，我们能够对Kiguel和Liviatan（1992）等研究提出的产出扩张观点进行细化，并确定该扩张减弱甚至可能消失的条件。最后，尽管所有发现均为理论性的，但它们蕴含了可在未来研究中检验的实证含义。

title: Treatment Targeting by Scaled Behavioral Measurement
title_zh: 基于缩放行为测量的靶向治疗
authors: Kevin Bauer & Andreas Grunewald & Florian Hett & Johanna Jagow & Maximilian Speicher
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how behavioral economics and machine learning can jointly construct effective treatment-targeting rules. In a large field experiment at an online fashion retailer with approximately 500,000 consumers, we test a loss-framed discount message. We elicit individual loss aversion in a nested incentivized behavioral measurement experiment (N=582) and use machine learning to impute it from digital footprints. Targeting based on scaled behavioral measurement yields statistically significant revenue gains and outperforms causal forests. The results show how scaling behavioral measurement can improve algorithmic treatment assignment relative to purely data-driven approaches, especially when pilot data are unavailable, noisy, or costly.
abstract_zh: 我们研究行为经济学与机器学习如何共同构建有效的处理目标规则。在一项涉及约50万名消费者的在线时尚零售商大规模实地实验中，我们测试了一种损失框架折扣信息。我们在嵌套的激励性行为测量实验（N=582）中测量了个体损失厌恶程度，并利用机器学习从数字足迹中对其进行插补。基于规模化行为测量的目标定位带来了统计上显著的收益增长，且表现优于因果森林。研究结果表明，相较于纯粹的数据驱动方法，规模化行为测量能够改进算法处理分配，尤其是在缺乏试点数据、数据存在噪声或成本高昂的情况下。

title: Transmission of Negative Interest Rates: Reversal or Amplification?
title_zh: 负利率的传导：逆转还是放大？
authors: Jan Lukas Schäfer
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Previous studies have shown that banks avoid passing negative monetary policy rates through to depositors, implying losses in deposit taking that erode equity and eventually have a negative impact on the lending of capital constrained banks. This paper shows that unconstrained banks respond differently, increasing loan supply even more with a deposit zero lower bound (D-ZLB) than without it. As a result, rate cuts below zero can be more stimulative than in positive territory, provided enough banks are unconstrained. A calibrated dynamic model finds this effect substantial, increasing aggregate loan supply by about 9% despite equity erosion pressures.
abstract_zh: 以往研究表明，银行会避免将负利率货币政策传导至存款人，这导致存款业务亏损侵蚀资本，并最终对资本受限银行的贷款产生负面影响。本文发现，不受约束的银行对此反应不同：在存款零下限（D-ZLB）环境下，其贷款供给增幅甚至超过无此约束时的水平。因此，只要存在足够多的不受约束银行，负利率政策下的降息可能比正利率区间更具刺激效应。经校准的动态模型显示，尽管存在资本侵蚀压力，该效应仍使总贷款供给增加约9%。

title: New Evidence on the Health-Status Gradient from Imperial China
title_zh: DP21646 来自中华帝国关于健康状况梯度的新证据
authors: Wolfgang Keller, Carol Shiue, Karen Eggleston
official: 官方在线 2026-06-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the relationship between health and social status in China using genealogical data from the 14th to 19th centuries. The data covers broad segments of the population linking husbands, wives, and sons, allowing us to examine whether status was associated with survival not only for adult men but also across households and generations. In a sample centered on the early 1700s, the typical lifespan of married men is 52, but varies widely. High-status men have a 22 percent higher probability of living past 50 than low-status men, resulting in a lifespan advantage of seven years. High status is also associated with significant survival advantages for wives and children. The lifespan premium of the wife of a high-status man over the wife of a commoner exceeds 10 years, and the chance that the son of a high-status man dies before reaching 10 years is less than half that of a low-status man’s son. Up to the 17th century the lifespan advantage is largely confined to those with top status, while the healthstatus gradient across all status levels emerges during the 18th century. The findings provide new evidence on health-status inequality in a less-studied setting, and suggest that health-status inequality is usefully analyzed from a family and intergenerational perspective.
abstract_zh: 本文利用14至19世纪中国的家谱数据，研究健康与社会地位之间的关系。数据覆盖了广泛的社会阶层，将丈夫、妻子和儿子联系起来，使我们能够考察地位是否不仅与成年男性的生存状况相关，还涉及家庭内部及代际之间的影响。在以18世纪初为中心的样本中，已婚男性的典型寿命为52岁，但个体差异显著。高地位男性活过50岁的概率比低地位男性高22%，寿命优势达七年。高地位还与妻子和子女的显著生存优势相关：高地位男性妻子的寿命比平民妻子长超过10年，而高地位男性之子在10岁前死亡的概率不到低地位男性之子的一半。直至17世纪，寿命优势主要局限于顶级地位群体，而18世纪期间，所有地位层级之间均出现了健康-地位梯度。这些发现为较少被研究的背景下的健康-地位不平等提供了新证据，并表明从家庭和代际视角分析健康-地位不平等具有重要价值。

title: A Tale of Demand and Supply for Central Bank Reserves
title_zh: 中央银行准备金需求与供给的故事
authors: Sriya Anbil, Sebastian Infante, Zeynep Senyuz
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In an ample-reserves framework, administered rates anchor money markets but suppress information from unsecured interbank trading. We recover that information by isolating the small interbank segment of the federal funds market. Using high-frequency bank-level data, we employ deposit shocks as an instrument for bank borrowing demand. Our analysis reveals that non-bank lenders, such as Federal Home Loan Banks, supply funds elastically, whereas bank lenders exhibit price inelasticity, which intensifies as their reserve balances decline, particularly for bankers’ banks. This interbank segment highlights distributional frictions in the federal funds market that emerge well before aggregate reserves become scarce and provides new evidence on monetary policy transmission in an ample-reserves regime.

abstract: I. Gaps in Global AI Adoption As artificial intelligence (AI) is shaping the global economy and society as a general-purpose technology (GPT), there is increasing concern that disparities in countries’ capacity to adopt AI may further widen. While AI holds significant potential to enhance productivity, foster economic growth, and expand trade, its benefits may become concentrated in a limited number of leading countries and firms due to the unequal distribution of technology, capital, talent, and data. In particular, many developing countries face structural constraints in adopting AI, primarily due to insufficient digital infrastructure, limited human capital, and underdeveloped institutional frameworks. Over the medium to long term, these constraints risk exacerbating global growth gaps and socioeconomic inequality. We employ the IMF’s AI Preparedness Index (AIPI) to assess national AI adoption capacity by income group. As shown in Figure 1, there are substantial cross-national gaps in AI preparedness. High-income countries generally have foundations in regulation and ethics, digital infrastructure, human capital, and innovation. Upper-middle-income countries are heterogeneous as a group, but many are likely to have a strong willingness to accelerate innovation based upon a substantial level of human capital. For lower-middle- and low-income countries, improving digital infrastructure is an urgent priority while also treating development of human resources as a key policy consideration (see Figure 2). These cross-country gaps are closely linked to differences in the level of progress toward the Sustainable Development Goals. SDG indicators show a strong correlation with AIPI, suggesting that the achievement of the SDGs has a significant influence as a foundational condition for AI readiness (see Table 1).
abstract_zh: 一、全球人工智能采纳的差距 随着人工智能作为通用技术重塑全球经济与社会，各国在采纳人工智能能力上的差距可能进一步扩大的担忧日益加剧。尽管人工智能在提升生产率、促进经济增长和扩大贸易方面潜力巨大，但由于技术、资本、人才和数据分布不均，其收益可能集中于少数领先国家和企业。特别是许多发展中国家面临结构性制约，主要源于数字基础设施不足、人力资本有限以及制度框架不完善。中长期来看，这些制约可能加剧全球增长差距和社会经济不平等。 我们采用国际货币基金组织的人工智能准备指数，按收入组别评估各国的人工智能采纳能力。如图1所示，各国在人工智能准备度上存在显著差距。高收入国家通常在监管与伦理、数字基础设施、人力资本和创新方面具备基础。中高收入国家作为群体具有异质性，但许多国家可能在较高人力资本水平基础上展现出强烈的创新加速意愿。对于中低收入和低收入国家而言，改善数字基础设施是当务之急，同时需将人力资源开发作为关键政策考量（见图2）。这些跨国差距与可持续发展目标进展水平的差异密切相关。可持续发展目标指标与人工智能准备指数呈现强相关性，表明可持续发展目标的实现作为人工智能准备的基础条件具有重要影响（见表1）。

abstract: We study how information disclosure shapes social learning about a potentially harmful product. Increased transparency helps early agents avoid harm, which may undermine learning by later agents. Despite this conflict of interest, we show that full transparency is uniquely optimal for all agents when they learn only by observing neighbors’ harm. We investigate whether full transparency about harm continues to benefit all agents when they also learn from additional, imperfect signals. (JEL D18, D82, D83, L15)

title: Optimal Healthcare Contracts: Theory and Empirical Evidence
title_zh: 最优医疗合同：理论与实证证据
authors: Paolo Berta, Gianni De Fraja, Stefano Verzillo
official: 官方在线 2026-05-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the contracts offered by a large healthcare purchaser to health service providers. Contracts are based on the DRG principle that all hospitalizations in a diagnosis group are reimbursed at the same rate. This principle is relaxed in practice, as in several cases, the amount reimbursed within each DRG exhibits considerable variability. We build a theoretical model which explains this variability as the attempt of the health authority to ensure appropriate matching between hospitals and patients. We test the model using a very large and detailed administrative data set for the largest region in Italy. In line with our theoretical results, we show that the state funded purchaser offers providers a system of incentives such that, as required by optimality, that providers which treat more patients receive a higher average reimbursement per treatment, suggesting therefore that they treat on average more difficult patients and are compensated for doing so.
abstract_zh: 本文研究大型医疗采购方向医疗服务提供者提供的合同。合同基于诊断相关分组（DRG）原则，即同一诊断组内的所有住院治疗均按相同费率报销。然而在实践中，这一原则有所放宽——在多个案例中，每个DRG内的报销金额呈现出显著差异。我们构建了一个理论模型，将这种差异解释为卫生当局为确保医院与患者之间实现恰当匹配的尝试。我们利用意大利最大地区极为详尽的管理数据集对模型进行检验。与理论结果一致，我们发现，国家资助的采购方向提供者提供了一套激励机制：根据最优性要求，治疗患者数量越多的提供者，其每次治疗的平均报销金额越高，这表明他们平均治疗了病情更复杂的患者，并因此获得相应补偿。
